integrity: The proof is analytic for all finite graphs. The exact-rational verifier checks representative complete multipartite extremizers only and is explicitly corroborative.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns weight-two Boolean edge-shell supports and vertex blow-ups; it does not classify all extremizers or identify the Turán value with a graph coloring invariant for every graph.
title: Blow-up invariance of Boolean edge-shell Turán extrema
